task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: To remove only BOX_MIDDLE from the stack, we must first remove BOX_TOP (since only the top of the stack can be picked), temporarily place it on TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally put BOX_TOP back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is on top of BOX_MIDDLE, which is on top of BOX_BOTTOM, forming a stack.
Only the topmost box of the stack can be picked at any time.
TEMP_TABLE is used as a temporary holding location for BOX_TOP.
The robot interaction distance of 2.0 is sufficient to interact with objects after navigating near them.
Navigation tolerance of 0.5 is sufficient to get within interaction distance.
